description: This file defines an Angular component 'ReportsComponent' responsible for generating various reports such as customer bills, monthly reports, and revenue summaries. It interacts with an ApiService to fetch data and manages UI state indicators like loading and error messages.

classes.name: ReportsComponent
classes.description: Main Angular component for handling report generation and display on the frontend dashboard.

methods.name: selectReport
methods.description: Sets the active report type and loads corresponding data if necessary.

methods.name: loadCustomers
methods.description: Fetches the list of customers from the API for use in report generation.

methods.name: generateCustomerBill
methods.description: Generates a customer bill report for the selected customer.

methods.name: generateMonthlyReport
methods.description: Generates a monthly report based on selected year and month.
